tech-route-comparison v1.0.0

- Initial release providing evidence-backed comparison of technical routes, architectures, and solution paths.
- Supports multiple modes: overview, compare, maturity, and opportunity mapping.
- Includes explicit scope freeze, comparison normalization, and rubric-driven maturity assessment.
- Requires documentation of counterevidence and update triggers for all recommendations.
- Tool-agnostic workflow detects and selects the best available evidence retrieval tier, with explicit fallback handling.
- Delivers a structured set of Markdown work files to support traceability and management-grade reporting.
